incidents.body: From 5:50PM 3/6 UTC to 1:15AM 3/7 UTC, there was a bug that would cause library publishes to be incorrect. Files pulling in those updates would experience errors related to conflicting properties in variants. The issue with library publishes has been resolved. If you continue to see this error, please re-publish the affected components (by making a small change) and re-update the consuming files to apply the fix.

incidents.body: From 19:38 UTC to 4:10 UTC, Figma was degraded or unavailable due to failures in AWS and other dependencies. We've completed all mitigations and have been monitoring the situation for a few hours now without issues. We haven't seen any abnormal issues since our 4:10 UTC update, so we are marking the incident resolved. We will continue to monitor closely through the night.
